title: Evidence-Aware Risk-Bounded Access-Key Policy Selection for Zero-Trust Data Centers: Research Artifact
description: Reproducible single-host laboratory artifact for evidence-aware access--key policy selection in LONTAR-ZT. It contains frozen protocol, split manifests, source snapshot, measured outcome logs, policy-selection locks, and analysis outputs for 16 tuning, 107 certification, and 100 untouched test blocks (9,366 measured requests). The artifact evaluates a finite family of permit lifetime and live-evidence deadline combinations. It does not validate multi-host, multi-device, cross-day, remote-attestation, production key-manager, or general operational reliability claims. Original code is MIT; synthetic measurements and original documentation are CC BY 4.0. Runtime secrets, vendor binaries, external traffic datasets, and formatted manuscript PDF are excluded.
